medium: Original digital paintings generated for this film using OpenAI ImageGen. Existing game art informed the visual brief. No modern external illustration was supplied.
use: Production film artwork. Documentary references identify the underlying historical event. The painted compositions are reconstructions.

assets.description: Sydney quayside and cargo boom. The berth, distant landscape and people are reconstructed. Raynal records loading the schooner for the expedition (S004, pp. 38–39).
An original isolated cargo case, canvas and two slings. The ropes tighten and the load rises from its shadow. The precise packing and hoist are staged.
